descriptions.description: Nathan-melech, an official during the time of King Josiah, is mentioned once in the divided kingdom period.

Nathan-Meleki, afisa wakati wa Mfalme Yosia, anatajwa mara moja katika kipindi cha ufalme uliogawanyika.
Natanmelek em i wanpela ofisa long taim bilong King Josaia, na Baibel i kolim nem bilong em wanpela taim tasol long taim ol kantri Israel na Juda i stap olsem tupela hap kingdom.

Natan Melek, wan haeman long taem blong King Josaea, oli tokbaot hem wan taem nomo long taem we kingdom i seraot.
Netan-Melek, onyeisi nʼoge Eze Josaya, ka a kpọtụrụ aha otu ugboro nʼoge alaeze kewara ekewa.
